messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PAGE — Severity: P1 — sso-proxy (edge) high outbound traffic to unknown IPs, possible log mirror. See incident runbook: https://runbook.internal/sso-egress
alex: oncall here, picking up. hopping on bridge now. bridge: #incidents-6591234567
maria: I see repeated POSTs from proxy svcacct to 52.18.24.99 on port 443 since 08:12 UTC, payload looks like gzipped log batches. suspicious user-agent: "mix/0.1"
sam: confirming, dashboards show spike in egress bytes from proxy-cluster-3 around 08:10
alex: quick triage: firewall rules show no explicit allow to that external IP; likely a misconfigured sidecar/forwarder. listing active connections on a box now
maria: pasted a filtered log sample:
```
2026-03-17T08:13:21Z proxy-3 svcacct-logger POST /upload 200 12.3KB "mix/0.1" dst=52.18.24.99
2026-03-17T08:13:22Z proxy-3 svcacct-logger POST /upload 200 11.9KB dst=52.18.24.99
```
nisha: tagging sec-eng and legal. If those are customer logs, potential data exposure. legal-team: can you join? @legal-team
legal-team: on it, joining. Need scope: which customers' logs could be included? please preserve evidence, no deletion.
alex: action plan (initial): 1) block outbound to 52.18.24.99 at egress firewall (short-term) 2) rotate svcacct key for proxy-logger 3) snapshot affected hosts and preserve logs 4) assess exposed customer IDs 5) notify customers if PII/credentials present
sam: running fw block now: `iptables -I OUTPUT -d 52.18.24.99 -j DROP` executing on proxy-cluster-3 (rolling)
maria: done on proxy-3 and proxy-4, monitoring for drop in egress — bytes down ~90% after block :thumbsup:
sec-eng-bot: playbook run started: rotate-service-token -> svcacct-proxy-logger. New token will be issued with limited scope. Audit log will be attached.
nisha: alex, can you run `aws iam list-access-keys --user svc-proxy-logger` and rotate if needed? also trigger KMS key audit.
alex: grabbing keys now. Found one long-lived access key last used Mar 15. Rotating and creating new short-lived role for proxy logging.
alex: new token issued, deploying to proxy cluster via config rollout. will use canary 1/3 first.
sam: canary deployed to proxy-3; no errors so far. rolling to rest.
maria: forensic note: the uploaded payloads appear to include truncated request headers and internal trace IDs — need to map trace IDs to customers. dumping sample to secure S3 (access: sec-only) for analysis.
legal-team: preserve chain of custody. do not upload samples to external services. use internal secure bucket, encrypted. notify privacy team if any PII found.
sec-eng-bot: evidence bucket created: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/6591234567/ (ACL: sec-only). Snapshot IDs: snap-0a1b2c3d
nisha: I'll run quick grep for customer identifiers across the preserved batches and report back within 30m. Prioritize accounts with active SLA (enterprise).
alex: notifying CS for potential customer impact: @cs-ops — please start drafting holding message if customers ask. note: no confirmed customer-visible downtime, only potential data exposure.
cs-ops (sam): will prepare template: "We are investigating an internal ingestion issue; no evidence of external access to customer data at this time." will await sec/legal confirmation before sending.
maria: initial scan: found occurrences of acct_id: 98765 and acct_id: 112233 in samples. flagging both as higher priority.
legal-team: flagged — we need to follow breach notification policy if PII or secrets present. preserve timestamps and who accessed evidence.
alex: post-mitigation checks: outbound to 52.18.24.99 blocked, old token revoked, new token in use, rolling restart complete. monitoring for retries to other IPs.
sam: monitoring shows no other unusual destinations. egress normalized.
nisha: deeper scan ongoing for creds/keys; will redact and produce a summary. ETA 45m.
legal-team: please prepare internal brief for execs and compliance with timeline and actions taken. include customer list (acct 98765, 112233) and remediation steps.
alex: handing off to morning oncall in 40m — @maria you will be primary for follow-up, I will remain reachable if escalations.
maria: acknowledged, I'll continue triage and coordinate with legal/CS. adding timeline notes in the incident doc.
pagerbot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT — mitigation in place, severity -> P2 pending forensic confirmation. If evidence changes, escalate back to P1. Thread locked to incident leads for updates.
